- each crossing face's probe is held by any part of the set;
- each crossing point lies within REACH of the other face's plane, along that face's normal.

Nothing asks whether the air between the two points is a gap at all. At a grazing slant both conditions hold while the line crosses open air between two hidden gaps, each probe held by a part beside the line.
